semantics: LawSamples is request-local canonical array-pair DTO; at least two samples; parameter finite in [0,1], strictly increasing, first parameter 0.0 and last parameter 1.0; scale finite and >0; accepted samples are normalized only for response metadata, not repaired
prohibited_fields: Linear fallback;S-shape fallback;freecad_source_commented geometry claim;cross-request LawSamples state;sample sorting;implicit endpoint insertion;scale repair

semantics: Interpolation without LawSamples has no executable CAD Core product contract and must not build a fallback shape
prohibited_fields: unsupported_property generic fallback;shape_summary for invalid request;Linear fallback;S-shape fallback

request_fields: Malformed LawSamples sample shape or fewer than two samples
semantics: Only array-pair samples [parameter,scale] are in contract for C6-M3 S1; object samples, scalar lists, missing entries, extra entries, strings, nulls, and short lists are invalid DTOs
prohibited_fields: coerce object samples;discard extra fields;implicit defaults;fallback shape

request_fields: LawSamples parameter nonfinite or out of range
semantics: NaN, infinity, non-number, parameter<0, and parameter>1 are invalid; CAD Core must not clamp into domain
prohibited_fields: silent clamping;drop invalid samples;fallback to Linear

request_fields: LawSamples parameter nonmonotonic or endpoint coverage missing
semantics: Parameters must be strictly increasing and must explicitly cover domain endpoints 0.0 and 1.0; CAD Core does not sort samples or inject endpoint samples
prohibited_fields: silent sorting;implicit endpoint insertion;fallback to S-shape

semantics: Scale must be finite and positive; zero, negative, NaN, infinity, and non-number scale values are invalid
prohibited_fields: absolute-value repair;implicit default scale;drop invalid sample

request_fields: Valid LawSamples but invalid profile/spine shape or unavailable executable law contract
semantics: A valid DTO alone is not enough to publish a shape; invalid profile/spine/PipeShell input reports shape diagnostics, and missing kernel/executor support reports no executable contract until S3/S4 close the backend gap
prohibited_fields: product_contract_required for valid DTO after S4;shape_summary for failed shape;fallback law
